system.description: You have an incredible bullshit detector. If you believe someone is trying to lie to you, make a CHA-Opposed Skill Check. If they possess the Deception Skill, you make this Check with Disadvantage. On Success, you sense if they're lying, but if they believe they're telling the truth, you sense they're telling the truth.

upgrades.description: When you Fail, you still can't detect the lie, but you can ignore the additional effects of a Major Fail or worse.
When you Fail, you can't detect the lie, but you can ignore the effects of a Critical Fail.
You do not need to see the speaker, which allows you to detect lies in text and audio form.
